Variants.Content: The development of Celtiberian Falcata Infantry exemplified the brutal pragmatism of ancient Mediterranean warfare. By coordinating specialized arms, standardized training, and flexible tactical subunits, commanders maximized shock power while adapting rapidly to changing battlefield crises.

Drill after drill in the blazing sun until the movements of Celtiberian Falcata Infantry became second nature! In the press of shield-to-shield combat, your training is the only thing keeping you breathing.

Mastery of Celtiberian Falcata Infantry separated victorious commanders from slaughtered fools. Rigorous doctrine and unrelenting discipline transform a mob of armed men into an invincible instrument of state will.
